meta.name: captain-sync-all
meta.description: Captain-only. Fetch, merge origin into master, merge unique worktree work into master, and sync all worktrees. The daily rhythm command. NEVER pushes to remote. NEVER rebases. NEVER resets to origin. Formerly `/sync-all` — v2 rename to captain-actor-verb.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动同步多个 git 工作树到最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天要手动合并多个工作树的分支
copy.tagline_en: Automatically sync multiple git worktrees to latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually merge multiple worktrees daily

howto.what: 当Claude以Captain身份运行时，此技能会从远程仓库获取最新代码，将远程master合并到本地master，然后逐个检查每个工作树（worktree），将其中独有的提交合并到master（需确认），最后将所有工作树同步到更新后的master。它**不会**推送任何内容到远程，也不会变基或重置。
howto.when: 在PR合并后自动触发（作为/pr-captain-post-merge的步骤5），或在工作树完成/iteration-complete、/phase-complete等阶段性任务后由Captain手动输入/captain-sync-all，也可在会话开始时使用以捕获隔夜漂移。

say.text: 合并工作树提交并同步所有。

say.note: 用于会话开始时的漂移检查。

howto.what_en: When Claude acts as Captain, this skill fetches from remote, merges origin/master into local master, merges unique worktree commits into master (with confirmation), then syncs all worktrees to the updated master. It NEVER pushes, rebases, or resets to origin.
howto.when_en: Auto-triggered after a PR merge (as Step 5 of /pr-captain-post-merge), or manually invoked by Captain after agent events like /iteration-complete, /phase-complete, etc. Also used at session start to catch overnight drift.

say_en.text: Merge worktree commits and sync all.

say_en.note: Used at session start for drift check.
